a.lede: Paramount now owns Warner Bros. as last-ditch effort to stop $111B merger fails.
a.title: Paramount completes $111B Warner merger, creating “Skydance” behemoth

b.lede: New media empire will be known as Skydance, with CEO David Ellision calling it a 'historic day.'
b.title: Controversial $110 billion mega-merger of Paramount and Warner Bros. finally closes
